name: ui-scroll-compact
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game UI keyframe, partly unrolled story parchment
Primary request: One short wide parchment scroll viewed straight-on, opened vertically about halfway. Crooked wooden roller across the top and another across the bottom; broad completely blank cream paper center for HTML text overlay.
Input images: attached sheep, gate, patched sail are style references only.
Style/medium: deliberately primitive old Windows MS Paint mouse doodle matching references; true-black jagged stair-stepped outline; lopsided hand-drawn rollers; flat bucket fills; sparse brown crease marks only near paper edges.
Composition/framing: isolated centered 4:3 scroll, entire silhouette including every ribbon and roller end fully visible, minimum 15% transparent margin on all four sides. Keep central 70% visually empty and nearly uniform pale cream.
Color palette: cream paper, mustard, warm brown, tiny dusty teal ties.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background; no element may touch or cross canvas edges; no text, symbols, letters, icons, characters, shadow, gradients, glossy light, polished vector edges, watermark. One scroll only.
